intent: Present a numbered sequential process as an infographic with large step numbers, titles, and descriptions.
invariants: 4 numbered step cards in a horizontal row (3 cols each)
each step has a dark header with large step number (32pt, accent_2 on accent_1)
step title in subtitle bold accent_1 below header
step description in body text below title
cards have subtle border on white background
step numbers formatted as zero-padded two digits (01, 02, ...)
variables: step number format (01/02 or 1/2 or A/B)
header bar kicker and title text
limitations: Original slide may use custom icons or images within step cards
Connector arrows between steps are not reproduced
